selection: Primary constructor varargs preserve projected array properties, JVM varargs flags and Kotlin metadata. Empty/natural/named packing, spread copies, primitive/wide/nullable/generic arrays, property mutability, constructor and superclass delegation, leading defaults and evaluation order execute through a fixed official Java caller and four Kotlin provider/frontend consumer combinations with verification.
